meta.description: Bronze tracks must contain raw source columns and lineage attributes
Bronze tracks must not be empty
track_id must not be null in Bronze tracks
Bronze charts must contain raw source columns and lineage attributes
rank must not be null in Bronze charts
date must not be null in Bronze charts
Bronze countries must contain ISO and UN M49 columns
alpha-3 country code must not be null in Bronze countries
Silver tracks schema must include typed audio features and genre arrays
track_id is primary key and must never be null
track_id must be completely unique after deduplication
track_id must be exactly 22 alphanumeric characters
track_name must be present in Silver (blank names quarantined)
artists string must not be null
popularity must be between 0 and 100
duration_ms must be positive (at least 1s)
danceability unit interval [0.0, 1.0]
energy unit interval [0.0, 1.0]
speechiness unit interval [0.0, 1.0]
acousticness unit interval [0.0, 1.0]
instrumentalness unit interval [0.0, 1.0]
liveness unit interval [0.0, 1.0]
valence unit interval [0.0, 1.0]
loudness in valid dB range [-60.0, 10.0]
pitch key must be in pitch class [0, 11]
mode must be 0 (minor) or 1 (major)
tempo must be > 0 and <= 300 BPM (0 sentinels set to null)
Silver charts must contain standardized column names and extracted track_id
Primary grain (date, region, chart_type, rank) must be unique
chart_date must not be null
chart_date must conform to ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD
chart_rank must not be null
chart rank must be between 1 and 200
chart region must not be null
chart_type must not be null
chart_type must be top200 or viral50
track_id parsed from URL must not be null
trend must be one of the 4 Spotify trend categories
iso_alpha2 must not be null (Namibia 'NA' recovered)
iso_alpha2 must be exactly 2 characters
iso_alpha3 must not be null
iso_alpha3 must be unique primary key
iso_alpha3 must be exactly 3 characters
track_id must not be null in genre bridge
genre must not be null in genre bridge
(track_id, genre) pairs must be unique
Quarantined tracks must document non-empty reject reasons
Quarantine rate must not breach error budget (0.1%)
chart_record_id SHA-256 key must not be null
chart_record_id must be unique across all chart entries
chart_year must be within 2010..2030
chart_month must be 1..12
chart_season must be winter, spring, summer, or autumn
chart_rank in Gold must be 1..200
Country analytics grain (region x chart_type) must be unique
chart_entries count must be positive
Every track_key in fact_chart must exist in dim_track
Every country_key in fact_chart must exist in dim_country
Every track_key in bridge_track_artist must exist in dim_track
Artist bridge credit_weight must sum strictly to 1.0 per track
Genre bridge weighting_factor must sum strictly to 1.0 per track
